Author: Wormzey
Name: [TPlog] Materia Sweep
Punchline: Extracts and retrieves materia across your inventory and armoury chest in one click.
Description: Goes through your inventory and armoury chest one item at a time, extracting materia from fully spiritbonded gear and optionally retrieving melded materia. Can skip anything registered to a gear set. Open with /materiasweep.
